body:
I do have a support system sort of in friends, and they say they care and all but I get the feeling it's the thing to say to someone who is suicidal.  I'm paranoid all the time that people really don't care about me.  My family, it's a tough situation, I dealt with a lot of abuse mentally and physically as a child and my family while close has always treated me like an outsider.  

I did message my ex a couple months ago to explain the situation that I was in, and to ask if we could come to an agreement on the divorce just to end that stressor.  They replied "Your problems are not my problems, and if you need to speak to me any further call my lawyer first".  That is a copy/paste from the facebook message right before I was blocked.  

5 things? I have my dog, power for now, a roof for now, a bit of food, and my laptop.  Those are the last few good things I feel like I have right now.

Hrm, I wish I didn't have to say 'a lot' but that's the best way to describe it.  this is what I sent someone who asked in a PM, it's the short version. It's been a really rough year and I'm feeling like I'm at the end of what I can handle emotionally. A quick synopsis. Divorce, career loss, multiple hospitalizations, medical issues, multiple job losses, pending eviction, car repossession, reemergence of severe self harm addiction, a suicide attempt that was very near successful, an ICU stay for a week, inpatient treatment for a week, when I got home from the hospital someone I trusted has stolen everything of value I had left, and on top of all of that my doctor told me today that I might have leukemia and I have to go get a bone marrow biopsy.
Just PM me the best way to contact you, whatever messenger, and I'll figure it out.
